notes: All mirror data previously used; expanded retrospective evaluation.
Five overlapping component splits; standard deviations describe these draws, not independent-dataset replication.
Rare F1 is mean subtype F1 of XSS and MITM, distinct from all-class macro F1.
Alarm recall and correct-subtype recall are separately reported.
No CE/balanced variant chosen on test results.
Binary AP/ROC for MAT-PV use its preserved graph alarm score, not invented hard-head subtype probabilities.
